Antichain.tile_count
statement:
Antichain.tile_count.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ}
  {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] {𝔄 : Set (𝔓 X)}
  (h𝔄 : IsAntichain (fun x1 x2 ↦ x1 ≤ x2) 𝔄) (ϑ : ↑(Set.range ⇑Q)) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
      (fun x ↦
        ∑ p with p ∈ 𝔄,
          (1 + edist_{𝔠 p, ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p / 4} (𝒬 p) ↑ϑ) ^ (-(2 * ↑a ^ 2 + ↑a ^ 3)⁻¹) *
              (E p).indicator 1 x *
            G.indicator 1 x)
      (ENNReal.ofReal (Antichain.p₆ a)) MeasureTheory.volume ≤
    ↑(Antichain.C6_1_6 a) * dens₁ 𝔄 ^ (Antichain.p₆ a)⁻¹ *
      MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ p ∈ 𝔄, ↑(𝓘 p)) ^ (Antichain.p₆ a)⁻¹

name: Antichain.tile_count_aux
statement:
Antichain.tile_count_aux.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ}
  {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] {𝔄 : Set (𝔓 X)}
  (h𝔄 : IsAntichain (fun x1 x2 ↦ x1 ≤ x2) 𝔄) (ϑ : ↑(Set.range ⇑Q)) {n : ℕ} :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
      (fun x ↦
        ∑ p ∈ (Antichain.𝔄_aux 𝔄 (↑ϑ) n).toFinset,
          2 ^ (-↑n * (2 * ↑a ^ 2 + ↑a ^ 3)⁻¹) * (E p).indicator 1 x * G.indicator 1 x)
      (ENNReal.ofReal (Antichain.p₆ a)) MeasureTheory.volume ≤
    (2 ^ ((↑𝕔 + 1) * ↑a ^ 3 - ↑n)) ^ (Antichain.p₆ a)⁻¹ * dens₁ 𝔄 ^ (Antichain.p₆ a)⁻¹ *
      MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ p ∈ 𝔄, ↑(𝓘 p)) ^ (Antichain.p₆ a)⁻¹

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₀
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₀ {q₀ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀)
  (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hq₀' : q₀ ≠ ⊤) :
  q₀.toReal + q₁⁻¹.toReal / (q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) * (q.toReal - q₀.toReal) =
    (1 - t).toReal * q.toReal

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₁
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₁ {q₀ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀)
  (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hq₀' : q₀ ≠ ⊤) :
  q₀⁻¹.toReal / (q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) * (q.toReal - q₀.toReal) = -t.toReal * q.toReal

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₂
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₂ {p₀ q₀ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹)
  (hq₀' : q₀ ≠ ⊤) :
  q₀.toReal / p₀.toReal +
      p₀⁻¹.toReal * q₁⁻¹.toReal / (q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) * (q.toReal - q₀.toReal) =
    (1 - t).toReal * p₀⁻¹.toReal * q.toReal

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₃
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₃ {q₀ p₁ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹)
  (hq₀' : q₀ ≠ ⊤) :
  p₁⁻¹.toReal * q₀⁻¹.toReal / (q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) * (q.toReal - q₀.toReal) =
    -t.toReal * p₁⁻¹.toReal * q.toReal

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₄
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₄ {q₀ q₁ : ENNReal} :
  q₀⁻¹.toReal / (q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) = -(q₀⁻¹.toReal / (q₀⁻¹.toReal - q₁⁻¹.toReal))

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₅
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₅ {q₀ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀)
  (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hq₁' : q₁ ≠ ⊤) :
  q₁.toReal + -(q₀⁻¹.toReal / (q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) * (q.toReal - q₁.toReal)) =
    t.toReal * q.toReal

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₆
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₆ {q₀ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀)
  (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hq₁' : q₁ ≠ ⊤) :

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₇
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.eq_exponents₇ {q₀ p₁ q₁ q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹)

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₁
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₁ {p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) :
  ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal =
    ((1 - t).toReal * p₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * p₁⁻¹.toReal) *
        ((1 - t).toReal * q₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₀⁻¹.toReal) /
      (((1 - t).toReal * q₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * q₁⁻¹.toReal) *
        ((1 - t).toReal * p₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * p₁⁻¹.toReal - p₀⁻¹.toReal))

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₂
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₂ {p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) :
  ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal =
    ((1 - t).toReal * p₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * p₁⁻¹.toReal) *
        ((1 - t).toReal * q₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * q₁⁻¹.toReal - q₁⁻¹.toReal) /
      (((1 - t).toReal * q₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * q₁⁻¹.toReal) *
        ((1 - t).toReal * p₀⁻¹.toReal + t.toReal * p₁⁻¹.toReal - p₁⁻¹.toReal))

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₃
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₃ {p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ p q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hp₁ : 0 < p₁) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ ≠ p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁)
  (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hp₀' : p₀ ≠ ⊤)
  (hq₀' : q₀ ≠ ⊤) :
  ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal =
    p₀.toReal * (q₀.toReal - q.toReal) / (q₀.toReal * (p₀.toReal - p.toReal))

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₄
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₄ {p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ p q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hp₁ : 0 < p₁) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ ≠ p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁)
  (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hp₁' : p₁ ≠ ⊤)
  (hq₁' : q₁ ≠ ⊤) :
  ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal =
    p₁.toReal * (q₁.toReal - q.toReal) / (q₁.toReal * (p₁.toReal - p.toReal))

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₅
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₅ {p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ p q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hp₁ : 0 < p₁) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ ≠ p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁)
  (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hp₀' : p₀ ≠ ⊤)
  (hq₀' : q₀ ≠ ⊤) :
  p₀.toReal +
      (ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal)⁻¹ * (q.toReal - q₀.toReal) *
        (p₀.toReal / q₀.toReal) =
    p.toReal

name: ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₆
statement:
ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ_equality₆ {p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ p q t : ENNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
  (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hp₁ : 0 < p₁) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ ≠ p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁)
  (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hp₁' : p₁ ≠ ⊤)
  (hq₁' : q₁ ≠ ⊤) :
  p₁.toReal +
      (ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal)⁻¹ * (q.toReal - q₁.toReal) *
        (p₁.toReal / q₁.toReal) =
    p.toReal

  (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹) (hp₀' : p₀ ≠ ⊤)
  (hq₀' : q₀ = ⊤) :
  ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal = p₀.toReal / (p₀.toReal - p.toReal)

statement:
ENNReal.eLpNorm_Ioc_convolution_le_enorm_mul.{u𝕜, uE, uE', uF} {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} {E : Type uE}
  {E' : Type uE'} {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup E']
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E']
  [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) (a : ℝ) {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)]
  {p q r : ENNReal} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hpqr : p⁻¹ + q⁻¹ = r⁻¹ + 1) {f : ℝ → E}
  {g : ℝ → E'} (hgT : Function.Periodic g T)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume)
  (hg : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g MeasureTheory.volume) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun x ↦ ∫ (y : ℝ) in a..a + T, (L (f y)) (g (x - y))) r
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a (a + T))) ≤
    ‖L‖ₑ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a (a + T))) *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g q (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a (a + T)))

  [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) (a : ℝ) {T : ℝ} [hT : Fact (0 < T)]
  {p q r : ENNReal} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hpqr : p⁻¹ + q⁻¹ = r⁻¹ + 1) {f : ℝ → E}
  {g : ℝ → E'} (hgT : Function.Periodic g T)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f MeasureTheory.volume)
  (hg : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g MeasureTheory.volume) (c : ℝ)
  (hL : ∀ (x y : ℝ), ‖(L (f x)) (g y)‖ ≤ c * ‖f x‖ * ‖g y‖) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun x ↦ ∫ (y : ℝ) in a..a + T, (L (f y)) (g (x - y))) r
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a (a + T))) ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal c *
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a (a + T))) *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g q (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a (a + T)))

ENNReal.enorm_convolution_le_eLpNorm_mul_eLpNorm_mul_eLpNorm.{u𝕜, uG, uE, uE', uF} {𝕜 : Type u𝕜}
  {G : Type uG} [MeasurableSpace G] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure G} {E : Type uE} {E' : Type uE'}
  {F : Type uF} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E'] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
  [NormedSpace ℝ F] {L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F} [AddGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G]
  [IsTopologicalAddGroup G] [BorelSpace G] [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [LocallyCompactSpace G]
  [SecondCountableTopology G] [μ.IsNegInvariant] {p q r : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
  (hpqr : p⁻¹ + q⁻¹ = r⁻¹ + 1) {f : G → E} {g : G → E'}
  (hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hg : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable g μ)
  (c : ℝ) (hL : ∀ (x y : G), ‖(L (f x)) (g y)‖ ≤ c * ‖f x‖ * ‖g y‖) (x : G) :
  ‖MeasureTheory.convolution f g L μ x‖ₑ ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal c *
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (fun y ↦ (‖f y‖ₑ ^ p * ‖g (x - y)‖ₑ ^ q) ^ (1 / r)) (ENNReal.ofReal r)
          μ *
      (MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ ^ ((r - p) / r) *
        MeasureTheory.eLpNorm g (ENNReal.ofReal q) μ ^ ((r - q) / r))

statement:
MeasureTheory.HasRestrictedWeakType.hasLorentzType.{u_1, u_2, u_7, u_8} {α : Type u_1}
  {α' : Type u_2} {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {m : MeasurableSpace α'} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {ε' : Type u_7} [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite μ] {𝕂 : Type u_8}
  [RCLike 𝕂] [TopologicalSpace ε'] [ENormedAddCommMonoid ε'] {T : (α → 𝕂) → α' → ε'} {p q : ENNReal}
  (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) (p_ne_top : p ≠ ⊤) (q_ne_top : q ≠ ⊤) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite ν]
  {c : NNReal} (c_pos : 0 < c) (hT : MeasureTheory.HasRestrictedWeakType T p q μ ν ↑c)
  (T_meas :
    ∀ {f : α → 𝕂}, MeasureTheory.MemLorentz f p 1 μ → MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (T f) ν)
  (T_subadd :
    ∀ {f g : α → 𝕂},
      MeasureTheory.MemLorentz f p 1 μ →
        MeasureTheory.MemLorentz g p 1 μ → ∀ᵐ (x : α') ∂ν, ‖T (f + g) x‖ₑ ≤ ‖T f x‖ₑ + ‖T g x‖ₑ)
  (T_submul : ∀ (a : 𝕂) (f : α → 𝕂), ∀ᵐ (x : α') ∂ν, ‖T (a • f) x‖ₑ ≤ ‖a‖ₑ * ‖T f x‖ₑ)
  (weakly_cont_T :
    ∀ {f : α → 𝕂} {fs : ℕ → α → 𝕂},
      MeasureTheory.MemLorentz f p 1 μ →
        (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fs n) μ) →
          (∀ (a : α), Monotone fun n ↦ ‖fs n a‖) →
            (∀ (a : α), Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ fs n a) Filter.atTop (nhds (f a))) →
              ∀ (G : Set α'),
                MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T f) 1 (ν.restrict G) ≤
                  Filter.limsup (fun n ↦ MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T (fs n)) 1 (ν.restrict G))
                    Filter.atTop)
  (T_zero : T 0 =ᵐ[ν] 0) (T_ae_eq_of_ae_eq : ∀ {f g : α → 𝕂}, f =ᵐ[μ] g → T f =ᵐ[ν] T g) :
  MeasureTheory.HasLorentzType T p 1 p ⊤ μ ν (4 * ↑c / p)

name: MeasureTheory.combine_estimates₀
statement:
MeasureTheory.combine_estimates₀.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1} {α' : Type u_2} {E₁ : Type u_4}
  {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'} {p q p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ : ENNReal}
  {C₀ C₁ : NNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {f : α → E₁}
  {t : ENNReal} {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {A : NNReal} (hA : 0 < A) [TopologicalSpace E₁]
  [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] {spf : ScaledPowerFunction}
  (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ < p₁)
  (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) (hT : MeasureTheory.SubadditiveTrunc T (↑A) f ν) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀)
  (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hF : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ⊤)
  (hspf : spf = ChoiceScale.spf_ch ⋯ hq₀q₁ ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ hC₀ hC₁ hF)
  (h₁T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (h₀T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀)
  (h₂T : MeasureTheory.PreservesAEStrongMeasurability T p) :
  ∫⁻ (x : α'), ‖T f x‖ₑ ^ q.toReal ∂ν ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * ↑A) ^ q.toReal * q.toReal) *
            ((if q₁ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ +
              (if q₀ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹) *
          ↑C₀ ^ ((1 - t).toReal * q.toReal) *
        ↑C₁ ^ (t.toReal * q.toReal) *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ ^ q.toReal

name: MeasureTheory.combine_estimates₁
statement:
MeasureTheory.combine_estimates₁.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1} {α' : Type u_2} {E₁ : Type u_4}
  {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'} {p q p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ : ENNReal}
  {C₀ C₁ : NNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {f : α → E₁}
  {t : ENNReal} {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {A : NNReal} (hA : 0 < A) [TopologicalSpace E₁]
  [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] {spf : ScaledPowerFunction}
  (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ < p₁)
  (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) (hT : MeasureTheory.SubadditiveTrunc T (↑A) f ν)
  (h₁T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (h₀T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀)
  (h₂T : MeasureTheory.PreservesAEStrongMeasurability T p) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁)
  (hF : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ⊤)
  (hspf : spf = ChoiceScale.spf_ch ⋯ hq₀q₁ ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ hC₀ hC₁ hF) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ↑A) * q ^ q⁻¹.toReal *
            ((if q₁ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ +
                (if q₀ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹) ^
              q⁻¹.toReal *
          ↑C₀ ^ (1 - t).toReal *
        ↑C₁ ^ t.toReal *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ

statement:
MeasureTheory.estimate_norm_rpow_range_operator.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1} {α' : Type u_2}
  {E₁ : Type u_4} {E₂ : Type u_5} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'}
  {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {q : ℝ} {f : α → E₁} [TopologicalSpace E₁] [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁]
  [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] (hq : 0 < q) (tc : StrictRangeToneCouple) {A : NNReal}
  (hA : 0 < A) (ht : MeasureTheory.SubadditiveTrunc T (↑A) f ν)
  (hTf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (T f) ν) :
  ∫⁻ (x : α'), ‖T f x‖ₑ ^ q ∂ν ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * ↑A) ^ q * q) *
      ∫⁻ (s : ENNReal),
        MeasureTheory.distribution (T (MeasureTheory.trunc f (tc.ton s))) s ν * s ^ (q - 1) +
          MeasureTheory.distribution (T (MeasureTheory.truncCompl f (tc.ton s))) s ν * s ^ (q - 1)

name: MeasureTheory.estimate_norm_rpow_range_operator'
statement:
MeasureTheory.estimate_norm_rpow_range_operator'.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1} {α' : Type u_2}
  {E₁ : Type u_4} {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'}
  {p q p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ : ENNReal} {C₀ C₁ : NNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {f : α → E₁} {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} [TopologicalSpace E₁]
  [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀)
  (hq₁ : 0 < q₁) (hp₁p : p < p₁) (hp₀p : p₀ < p) (tc : StrictRangeToneCouple)
  (hq₀' :
    q₀ = ⊤ →
      ∀ s > 0, MeasureTheory.distribution (T (MeasureTheory.truncCompl f (tc.ton s))) s ν = 0)
  (hq₁' :
    q₁ = ⊤ → ∀ s > 0, MeasureTheory.distribution (T (MeasureTheory.trunc f (tc.ton s))) s ν = 0)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) (hT₁ : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (hT₀ : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀) :
  ∫⁻ (s : ENNReal),
      MeasureTheory.distribution (T (MeasureTheory.trunc f (tc.ton s))) s ν * s ^ (q.toReal - 1) +
        MeasureTheory.distribution (T (MeasureTheory.truncCompl f (tc.ton s))) s ν *
          s ^ (q.toReal - 1) ≤
    (if q₁ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) *
        (↑C₁ ^ q₁.toReal *
          ∫⁻ (s : ENNReal),
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (MeasureTheory.trunc f (tc.ton s)) p₁ μ ^ q₁.toReal *
              s ^ (q.toReal - q₁.toReal - 1)) +
      (if q₀ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) *
        (↑C₀ ^ q₀.toReal *
          ∫⁻ (s : ENNReal),
            MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (MeasureTheory.truncCompl f (tc.ton s)) p₀ μ ^ q₀.toReal *
              s ^ (q.toReal - q₀.toReal - 1))

name: MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc
statement:
MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc.{u_1, u_4} {α : Type u_1} {E₁ : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → E₁} {p₀ q₀ q : ℝ} {spf : ScaledPowerFunction} {j : Bool}
  [TopologicalSpace E₁] [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hp₀q₀ : p₀ ≤ q₀)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)
  (hf₂ : MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (μ.restrict (Function.support fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ₑ)))
  (hpowers : if (j ^^ (spf_to_tc spf).mon) = true then q₀ < q else q < q₀)
  (hpow_pos : 0 < q₀ + spf.σ⁻¹ * (q - q₀)) :
  ∫⁻ (s : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0,
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (MeasureTheory.trnc j f ((spf_to_tc spf).ton (ENNReal.ofReal s)))
            (ENNReal.ofReal p₀) μ ^
          q₀ *
        ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ (q - q₀ - 1)) ≤
    spf.d ^ (q - q₀) * ENNReal.ofReal |q - q₀|⁻¹ *
      (∫⁻ (a : α) in Function.support fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ₑ,
          ‖f a‖ₑ ^ (p₀ + spf.σ⁻¹ * (q - q₀) * (p₀ / q₀)) ∂μ) ^
        (p₀⁻¹ * q₀)

name: MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc₁
statement:
MeasureTheory.estimate_trnc₁.{u_1, u_4} {α : Type u_1} {E₁ : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α}
  {p q p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → E₁} {t : ENNReal}
  {spf : ScaledPowerFunction} {j : Bool} [TopologicalSpace E₁] [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁]
  (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hq₀ : 0 < q₀) (hp₁ : 0 < p₁) (hq₁ : 0 < q₁)
  (hpq : MeasureTheory.sel j p₀ p₁ ≤ MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁)
  (hp' : MeasureTheory.sel j p₀ p₁ ≠ ⊤) (hq' : MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁ ≠ ⊤) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ < p₁)
  (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) * p₀⁻¹ + t * p₁⁻¹) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) * q₀⁻¹ + t * q₁⁻¹)
  (hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)
  (hf₂ : MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (μ.restrict (Function.support fun x ↦ ‖f x‖ₑ)))
  (hspf : spf.σ = ComputationsChoiceExponent.ζ p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ t.toReal) :
  ∫⁻ (s : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0,
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (MeasureTheory.trnc j f ((spf_to_tc spf).ton (ENNReal.ofReal s)))
            (MeasureTheory.sel j p₀ p₁) μ ^
          (MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁).toReal *
        ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ (q.toReal - (MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁).toReal - 1)) ≤
    spf.d ^ (q.toReal - (MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁).toReal) *
        ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - (MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁).toReal|⁻¹ *
      (MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ ^ p.toReal) ^
        ((MeasureTheory.sel j p₀ p₁).toReal⁻¹ * (MeasureTheory.sel j q₀ q₁).toReal)

      (fun f ↦ MeasureTheory.MemLp f p₀ μ ∨ MeasureTheory.MemLp f p₁ μ) (↑A) ν)

name: MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux
statement:
MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1}
  {α' : Type u_2} {E₁ : Type u_4} {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {f : α → E₁} {t : ENNReal}
  {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {p₀ p₁ q₀ q₁ p q : ENNReal} {A : NNReal} [TopologicalSpace E₁]
  [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] (hA : 0 < A)
  (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ < p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁)
  {C₀ C₁ : NNReal} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁)
  (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) / p₀ + t / p₁) (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) / q₀ + t / q₁)
  (hT : MeasureTheory.SubadditiveTrunc T (↑A) f ν) (h₀T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀)
  (h₁T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (h₂T : MeasureTheory.PreservesAEStrongMeasurability T p) (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
    ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ↑A) * q ^ q⁻¹.toReal *
            ((if q₁ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ +
                (if q₀ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹) ^
              q⁻¹.toReal *
          ↑C₀ ^ (1 - t).toReal *
        ↑C₁ ^ t.toReal *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ

statement:
MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux₁.{u_1, u_4} {α : Type u_1} {E₁ : Type u_4}
  {m : MeasurableSpace α} {p q p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {t : ENNReal}
  {f : α → E₁} [TopologicalSpace E₁] [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀)
  (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ = p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ < q₁) {C₀ C₁ : NNReal}
  (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) / p₀ + t / p₁)
  (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) / q₀ + t / q₁) (hF : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ⊤) :
  (ENNReal.ofReal q.toReal *
        ((((↑C₀ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ) ^ q₀.toReal *
              ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioo 0 (ChoiceScale.d p p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ C₀ C₁ μ f).toReal,
                ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (q.toReal - q₀.toReal - 1))) *
            if q₀ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) +
          ((↑C₁ * MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ) ^ q₁.toReal *
              ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ici (ChoiceScale.d p p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ C₀ C₁ μ f).toReal,
                ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (q.toReal - q₁.toReal - 1))) *
            if q₁ = ⊤ then 0 else 1)) ^
      q.toReal⁻¹ =
    q ^ q.toReal⁻¹ *
            ((ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹ * if q₀ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) +
                ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ * if q₁ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) ^
              q.toReal⁻¹ *
          ↑C₀ ^ (1 - t).toReal *
        ↑C₁ ^ t.toReal *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ

name: MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux₂
statement:

  {α' : Type u_2} {E₁ : Type u_4} {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'}
  {p q p₀ q₀ p₁ q₁ : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'}
  {t : ENNReal} {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {f : α → E₁} [TopologicalSpace E₁]
  [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀)
  (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ = p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ < q₁) {C₀ C₁ : NNReal}
  (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) / p₀ + t / p₁)
  (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) / q₀ + t / q₁) (h₀T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀)
  (h₁T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (h₂T : MeasureTheory.PreservesAEStrongMeasurability T p) (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
    q ^ q.toReal⁻¹ *
            ((ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹ * if q₀ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) +
                ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ * if q₁ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) ^
              q.toReal⁻¹ *
          ↑C₀ ^ (1 - t).toReal *
        ↑C₁ ^ t.toReal *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ

name: MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux₃
statement:
MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux₃.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1}
  {α' : Type u_2} {E₁ : Type u_4} {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {f : α → E₁} {t : ENNReal}
  {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {p₀ p₁ q₀ q₁ p q : ENNReal} [TopologicalSpace E₁]
  [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂] (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀)
  (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (hp₀p₁ : p₀ = p₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) {C₀ C₁ : NNReal}
  (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) / p₀ + t / p₁)
  (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) / q₀ + t / q₁) (h₀T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀)
  (h₁T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (h₂T : MeasureTheory.PreservesAEStrongMeasurability T p) (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
    q ^ q.toReal⁻¹ *
            ((ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹ * if q₀ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) +
                ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ * if q₁ = ⊤ then 0 else 1) ^

name: MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux₄
statement:
MeasureTheory.exists_hasStrongType_real_interpolation_aux₄.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_5} {α : Type u_1}
  {α' : Type u_2} {E₁ : Type u_4} {E₂ : Type u_5} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {m' : MeasurableSpace α'}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α'} {f : α → E₁} {t : ENNReal}
  {T : (α → E₁) → α' → E₂} {p₀ p₁ q₀ q₁ p q : ENNReal} {A : NNReal} (hA : 0 < A)
  [TopologicalSpace E₁] [ESeminormedAddMonoid E₁] [TopologicalSpace E₂] [ContinuousENorm E₂]
  (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₀) (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ Set.Ioc 0 q₁) (hq₀q₁ : q₀ ≠ q₁) {C₀ C₁ : NNReal}
  (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (hC₀ : 0 < C₀) (hC₁ : 0 < C₁) (hp : p⁻¹ = (1 - t) / p₀ + t / p₁)
  (hq : q⁻¹ = (1 - t) / q₀ + t / q₁) (hT : MeasureTheory.SubadditiveTrunc T (↑A) f ν)
  (h₀T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₀ q₀ μ ν ↑C₀)
  (h₁T : MeasureTheory.HasWeakType T p₁ q₁ μ ν ↑C₁)
  (h₂T : MeasureTheory.PreservesAEStrongMeasurability T p) (hf : MeasureTheory.MemLp f p μ) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
    (if p₀ = p₁ then 1 else ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ↑A)) * q ^ q⁻¹.toReal *
            ((if q₁ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₁.toReal|⁻¹ +
                (if q₀ < ⊤ then 1 else 0) * ENNReal.ofReal |q.toReal - q₀.toReal|⁻¹) ^
              q⁻¹.toReal *
          ↑C₀ ^ (1 - t).toReal *
        ↑C₁ ^ t.toReal *
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f p μ

name: Tile.I12_le
statement:
Tile.I12_le.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ} {F G : Set X}
  [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] (ha : 4 ≤ a) {p p' : 𝔓 X}
  (hle : 𝔰 p' ≤ 𝔰 p) {g : X → ℂ}
  (hinter :
    (Metric.ball (𝔠 p') (5 * ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p') ∩
        Metric.ball (𝔠 p) (5 * ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p)).Nonempty)
  (x1 : ↑(E p')) (x2 : ↑(E p)) :
  Tile.I12 p p' g ↑x1 ↑x2 ≤
    2 ^ ((2 * 𝕔 + 6 + 𝕔 / 4) * a ^ 3 + 8 * a + 1) *
            (1 + edist_{𝔠 p', ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p' / 4} (𝒬 p') (𝒬 p)) ^ (-(2 * ↑a ^ 2 + ↑a ^ 3)⁻¹) /
          MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (↑x2) (↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p)) *
        ‖g ↑x1‖ₑ *
      ‖g ↑x2‖ₑ

name: Tile.I12_le'
statement:
Tile.I12_le'.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ} {F G : Set X}
  [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] {p p' : 𝔓 X}
  (hle : 𝔰 p' ≤ 𝔰 p) {g : X → ℂ} (x1 : ↑(E p')) (x2 : ↑(E p)) :
  Tile.I12 p p' g ↑x1 ↑x2 ≤
    2 ^ ((2 * 𝕔 + 6 + 𝕔 / 4) * a ^ 3 + 8 * a) *
            (1 + edist_{↑x1, ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p'} (Q ↑x1) (Q ↑x2)) ^ (-(2 * ↑a ^ 2 + ↑a ^ 3)⁻¹) /
          MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (↑x2) (↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p)) *
        ‖g ↑x1‖ₑ *
      ‖g ↑x2‖ₑ

name: Tile.bound_6_2_26
Tile.bound_6_2_26_aux
statement:
Tile.bound_6_2_26_aux.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ}
  {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] {p p' : 𝔓 X} {g : X → ℂ} :
  have f := fun x ↦
    match x with
    | (x, z1, z2) =>
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (Ks (𝔰 p') z1 x) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑((Q z1) z1) - ↑((Q z1) x))) *
          g z1 *
        (Ks (𝔰 p) z2 x * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (-↑((Q z2) z2) + ↑((Q z2) x))) *
          (starRingEnd ℂ) (g z2));
  ∫⁻ (x : X × X) in E p' ×ˢ E p, ‖∫ (y : X), f (y, x)‖ₑ =
    ∫⁻ (z : X × X) in E p' ×ˢ E p, Tile.I12 p p' g z.1 z.2

name: Tile.bound_6_2_29
statement:
Tile.bound_6_2_29.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ} {F G : Set X}
  [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] (ha : 4 ≤ a) {p p' : 𝔓 X}
  (x2 : ↑(E p)) :
  2 ^ ((2 * 𝕔 + 6 + 𝕔 / 4) * a ^ 3 + 8 * a + 1) *
        (1 + edist_{𝔠 p', ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p' / 4} (𝒬 p') (𝒬 p)) ^ (-(2 * ↑a ^ 2 + ↑a ^ 3)⁻¹) /
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball (↑x2) (↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p)) ≤
    ↑(Tile.C6_1_5 a) *
        (1 + edist_{𝔠 p', ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p' / 4} (𝒬 p') (𝒬 p)) ^ (-(2 * ↑a ^ 2 + ↑a ^ 3)⁻¹) /
      MeasureTheory.volume ↑(𝓘 p)

Tile.boundedCompactSupport_aux_6_2_26
statement:

  (hg : Measurable g) (hg1 : ∀ (x : X), ‖g x‖ ≤ G.indicator 1 x) :
  MeasureTheory.BoundedCompactSupport
    (fun x ↦
      match x with
      | (x, z1, z2) =>
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (Ks (𝔰 p') z1 x) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑((Q z1) z1) - ↑((Q z1) x))) *
            g z1 *
          (Ks (𝔰 p) z2 x * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (-↑((Q z2) z2) + ↑((Q z2) x))) *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (g z2)))
    MeasureTheory.volume

statement:
Tile.complex_exp_lintegral.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ} {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ}
  {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] {p : 𝔓 X} {g : X → ℂ}
  (y : X) :
  (starRingEnd ℂ)
      (∫ (y1 : X) in E p,
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (Ks (𝔰 p) y1 y) * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (↑((Q y1) y1) - ↑((Q y1) y))) *
          g y1) =
    ∫ (y1 : X) in E p,
      Ks (𝔰 p) y1 y * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (-↑((Q y1) y1) + ↑((Q y1) y))) *
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (g y1)

                  s I = s J - k ∧
                    Disjoint ↑I ↑(𝓘 u₁) ∧
                      ¬Disjoint (↑J) (Metric.ball (c I) (8 * ↑(defaultD a) ^ s I)),
                  ∫⁻ (y : X) in ↑J,

                2) ^
          2⁻¹

  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] (n : ℕ) (𝔘 : Set (𝔓 X))
  (𝔗 : 𝔓 X → Set (𝔓 X)) (a✝ : ∀ {u : 𝔓 X}, u ∈ 𝔘 → (𝔗 u).Nonempty)
  (b : ∀ {u : 𝔓 X}, u ∈ 𝔘 → (𝔗 u).OrdConnected)
  (c : ∀ {u : 𝔓 X}, u ∈ 𝔘 → ∀ {p : 𝔓 X}, p ∈ 𝔗 u → 𝓘 p ≠ 𝓘 u)
  (d : ∀ {u : 𝔓 X}, u ∈ 𝔘 → ∀ {p : 𝔓 X}, p ∈ 𝔗 u → smul 4 p ≤ smul 1 u)
  (e : ∀ {x : X}, stackSize 𝔘 x ≤ 2 ^ n)
  (f : ∀ {u : 𝔓 X}, u ∈ 𝔘 → dens₁ (𝔗 u) ≤ 2 ^ (4 * ↑a - ↑n + 1))
  (g :
    ∀ {u u' : 𝔓 X},
      u ∈ 𝔘 →
        u' ∈ 𝔘 →
          u ≠ u' →
            ∀ {p : 𝔓 X},
              p ∈ 𝔗 u' →
                𝓘 p ≤ 𝓘 u →
                  2 ^ (defaultZ a * (n + 1)) < dist_{𝔠 p, ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p / 4} (𝒬 p) (𝒬 u))
  (h :
    ∀ {u : 𝔓 X},
      u ∈ 𝔘 → ∀ {p : 𝔓 X}, p ∈ 𝔗 u → Metric.ball (𝔠 p) (8 * ↑(defaultD a) ^ 𝔰 p) ⊆ ↑(𝓘 u))
  (p : 𝔓 X) :
  p ∈
      { 𝔘 := 𝔘, 𝔗 := 𝔗, nonempty' := a✝, ordConnected' := b, 𝓘_ne_𝓘' := c, smul_four_le' := d,

  (hf : MeasureTheory.BoundedCompactSupport f MeasureTheory.volume) :
  ‖carlesonSum ((fun x ↦ t.𝔗 x) u) (fun y ↦ Complex.exp (Complex.I * -↑((𝒬 u) y)) * f y) x‖ₑ ≤
    ↑(TileStructure.Forest.C7_1_3 a) *

              ‖f x‖)
            x' +
          t.boundaryOperator u
            (TileStructure.Forest.approxOnCube (TileStructure.Forest.𝓙 ((fun x ↦ t.𝔗 x) u)) fun x ↦
              ↑‖f x‖)
            x') +
      TileStructure.Forest.nontangentialMaximalFunction (𝒬 u)
        (TileStructure.Forest.approxOnCube (TileStructure.Forest.𝓙 ((fun x ↦ t.𝔗 x) u)) f) x'

div_vol_le✝.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {K : X → X → ℂ} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {s : ℤ}
  [KernelProofData a K] {x y : X} {c : ℝ} (hc : c > 0)
  (hxy : dist x y ≥ ↑(defaultD a) ^ (s - 1) / 4) (n : ℕ) :
  c / Real.vol x y ≤
    2 ^ ((2 + n) * a + 𝕔 * a ^ 3) * c /
      MeasureTheory.volume.real (Metric.ball x (2 ^ n * ↑(defaultD a) ^ s))

    2 ^ (1 + (𝕔 + 2) * a + (𝕔 + 1) * a ^ 3) /

statement:
lintegral_carlesonSum_𝔓₁_compl_le_sum_aux1.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ}
  {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ} {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G] {N : ℕ} :
  ∑ x ≤ N,
      ((12 + 8 * ↑(defaultZ a)) * ↑x ^ 0 + (19 + 20 * ↑(defaultZ a)) * ↑x ^ 1 +
            (7 + 16 * ↑(defaultZ a)) * ↑x ^ 2 +
          4 * ↑(defaultZ a) * ↑x ^ 3) *
        2 ^ (-((q - 1) / (8 * ↑a ^ 4) * ↑x)) ≤

  {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ} {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G] {N : ℕ} :
  ∑ x ≤ N,
      (12 + 8 * ↑(defaultZ a) + (19 + 20 * ↑(defaultZ a)) * ↑x + (7 + 16 * ↑(defaultZ a)) * ↑x ^ 2 +
          4 * ↑(defaultZ a) * ↑x ^ 3) *

name: lintegral_carlesonSum_𝔓₁_compl_le_sum_lintegral
statement:
lintegral_carlesonSum_𝔓₁_compl_le_sum_lintegral.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} {a : ℕ} {q : ℝ} {K : X → X → ℂ}
  {σ₁ σ₂ : X → ℤ} {F G : Set X} [MetricSpace X] [ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G]
  [TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)] {f : X → ℂ}
  (h'f : Measurable f) :
  ∫⁻ (x : X) in G \ G', ‖carlesonSum 𝔓₁ᶜ f x‖ₑ ≤
    (((∑ n ≤ maxℭ X,
            ∑ k ≤ n, ∑ l < n, ∫⁻ (x : X) in G \ G', ‖carlesonSum (𝔓pos ∩ 𝔓₁ᶜ ∩ 𝔏₀' k n l) f x‖ₑ) +
          ∑ n ≤ maxℭ X,
            ∑ k ≤ n,
              ∑ j ≤ 2 * n + 3,
                ∑ l ≤ defaultZ a * (n + 1),
                  ∫⁻ (x : X) in G \ G', ‖carlesonSum (𝔓pos ∩ 𝔓₁ᶜ ∩ 𝔏₁ k n j l) f x‖ₑ) +
        ∑ n ≤ maxℭ X,
          ∑ k ≤ n,
            ∑ j ≤ 2 * n + 3, ∫⁻ (x : X) in G \ G', ‖carlesonSum (𝔓pos ∩ 𝔓₁ᶜ ∩ 𝔏₂ k n j) f x‖ₑ) +
      ∑ n ≤ maxℭ X,
        ∑ k ≤ n,
          ∑ j ≤ 2 * n + 3,
            ∑ l ≤ defaultZ a * (n + 1),
              ∫⁻ (x : X) in G \ G', ‖carlesonSum (𝔓pos ∩ 𝔓₁ᶜ ∩ 𝔏₃ k n j l) f x‖ₑ
